# Homeschool of 1

> > A resource hub for homeschool families offering free printables, curriculum reviews, and hands-on learning activities for year-round celebration and teaching.

Homeschool of 1, created by Clare Brown, provides homeschooling families with educational activities, seasonal learning guides, and free printable resources. The site combines practical teaching tips with celebration guides and product recommendations to support customized homeschool curricula.

## Key Topics

- homeschool curriculum
- free printables
- educational activities
- hands-on learning
- seasonal learning
- holiday activities
- celebration guide
- teaching resources
- kids crafts
- monthly lessons
- curriculum reviews
- Teach and Celebrate the Year
- Clare Brown
- gift guides
- book lists

## Core Resources

- [Homeschool of 1](https://www.homeschoolof1.com): Homepage for Homeschool of 1 by Clare Brown with free printables and curriculum reviews.

## Products & Courses

- [Teach and Celebrate the Year](https://www.homeschoolof1.com/teach-and-celebrate-the-year): Product page for Teach and Celebrate the Year with 118 activities and teaching tips.
